nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What example is provided to illustrate the effects of increased aridity on ecosystem relationships?
nodes.answer: Research in the arid regions of northern China shows that the relationship between plant and microbial diversity and soil multifunctionality shifts when aridity exceeds a threshold of 0.82.
